quote: **SMS, email and other out-of-band codes**: CSPRNG, ≥ 20 bits (6 digits; 8 where usable), ≤ 10 min, single-use, bound to the login or transaction that asked for them (ASVS 5.0 V6.6.2), never logged, hashed at rest (against log and brief DB exposure, not offline cracking).
note: Section '## 5. MFA & account recovery'; an emailed login code is an out-of-band code: single-use.
